name: Java After Dark Necklace
materials: Gold-filled 14/20 star charm, end components and beads; PVD carabiner clasp; optional high quality gold plated letter charm, A to Z (+$3)
description: Handcrafted black Java gooseberry beads bring bold texture and subtle striped detail to this striking necklace. Each bead is made on the island of Java and paired with gold-filled accent beads, a gold-filled clasp, and a polished gold-filled star charm for a rich black-and-gold finish. Wear it as a standout piece or layer it with your favorite gold chains.
